title: Seaside Tiki Tours
specs: Children under 13 must wear a lifejacket while onboard at all times in accordance with state law.
Public 1.5 hours Tiki Tours: minimum 2 guests per booking.
Boat captain has right to cancel tour due to weather, safety, mechanical or behavioral problems. (Behavioral problems includes alcohol related cancellations).

services.name: Public 1.5 hours Tiki Tours
services.desc: Tour of the Barnegat Bay and backwaters on our Cruising Tiki Bar Boat 90 minutes About There's no better way to feel like a million bucks than spending a day out on the sea in your own exclusive charter. You can do just that when you book a private boat tour with Seaside Tiki Tours in Seaside Heights, NJ. Our boats come complete with a bathroom and tiki hut to ensure you have a comfortable ride. You're also welcome to bring any food and drinks you'd like. If you're celebrating an event and want to decorate, just let us know and you'll get half an hour of decorating time. Contact us All Ages • Up to 6 People
